info.title: Conduit Remote Control — proposed contract
info.description: DESIGN ONLY — NOT IMPLEMENTED. Session control review 2026-11-18. Business writes return 202; only operation receipts confirm application/save. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Cookie authentication is required except pairing. Writes additionally check exact Origin, Host and CSRF. read/control are workspace-scoped; configure grants host-wide configuration access. Every target, grant and version is rechecked on the GPUI owner thread. Payloads are sanitized; no endpoint returns saved API keys or protected key blobs.

post.description: Production HTTPS only. Exact Origin and Host checks apply. Secret expires after 120 seconds. Required scope: none; possession of one-time pairing secret.

patch.summary: Rename, pin or archive a session.
patch.description: Send explicit values and the ETag from GET on this path. Archiving preserves transcript, existing desktop tabs and drafts. Archiving during a run or cleanup returns 409 session_busy; a queued desktop message returns 409 queued_message_exists. Renaming or archiving during a pending send returns 409 send_pending. A successful receipt returns session_id and the metadata version. Required scope: control.

post.summary: Save a message, then release the existing runtime.
post.description: Use the session configuration ETag. Only starts an explicit text turn. Busy sessions or native aliases, archived sessions, and sessions with a desktop queued message fail with 409 session_busy, session_archived, or queued_message_exists respectively. A succeeded operation means saved and released, not completion of the model task. Before release the saving operation result includes session_id and run_id, also available in the authorized session projection and run events. Required scope: control.

post.summary: Request cancellation of the exact run.
post.description: No body required. Success records a cancellation request for the exact run and pauses its desktop queued message. In pending_save the launch gate stays closed and the send operation fails with 409 send_cancelled. Once started, cleanup is asynchronous and cleanup_blocked is nonterminal. An already stopping run can confirm the same request; a completed or replaced run returns 409 stale_run. Required scope: control.

get.summary: Read a command receipt belonging to this device.
get.description: The current device must own the operation and retain the original command scope and target grant. Results are retained in the current host epoch only.

get.summary: Read a sanitized projection and atomic subscription watermark.
get.description: workspace_id and session_id must match subsequent event subscription filters. Continuation pages bind the same snapshot revision; expiry requires a fresh snapshot. Required scope: read.

get.summary: Subscribe to ordered SSE replay and live state.
get.description: Use after for first resume, then the last id. If both cursor inputs are present they must match. Cursor is signed and binds epoch, filters and grant revision. 15-second heartbeat. Replay gap before headers: 409 replay_gap. Later overflow: resync_required without id, then close. Filtered event sequences may have gaps. Every request is authenticated; cursor is not a credential. Required scope: read.

200.description: text/event-stream; UTF-8 SSE frames. Each data payload follows RemoteEvent. Each id is an opaque cursor, except resync_required. Heartbeats are SSE comments.

RemoteCookie.name: __Host-conduit_remote
RemoteCookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/ cookie.

Expires.name: X-Conduit-Request-Expires
Expires.description: Original Unix expiry; must be within the next 10 minutes on first receipt. Retries retain this exact value.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exact strong ETag from this resource, including double quotes.

ArchiveFilter.name: archive
ArchiveFilter.description: Filter on the archived flag. This does not change run or pending-approval visibility.

Error.description: Structured error; code determines recovery. Resources outside the grant return 404.

scopes.description: All grants include read. control and configure are granted independently.

queued_message_state.description: Desktop queue state only. No queued text or attachments are exposed.

title.description: Clients trim outer whitespace before sending. The host also trims before validating nonempty input of at most 80 Unicode characters.

text.description: Also limited to 256 KiB of UTF-8 by the host.

base_url.description: No userinfo or secret query parameters.
No userinfo or secret query parameters.

version.description: Version of the resource changed by the command, such as the session metadata version after patchSessionMetadata.

OperationResult.description: Sanitized receipt only. Never echoes request bodies or credentials.

result.description: For a send in saving, session_id and run_id identify the pending run. The operation state indicates whether the save succeeded.

data.description: For a send rollback, resource is session_messages and resource_id is the session id. Discard cached messages and pagination cursors for that session.

RemoteEvent.description: JSON data in SSE frames. The id field is an opaque signed cursor; resync_required has no id. Heartbeat comments carry no business state.
